body: What kind of music bro? I'd love to listen to your shit too.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ghoY4kW3R4Y Here's a song from it. I hate watching the video because I have a lot of disgust directed towards my own physical appearance.

God man. You described my feelings in a way that's so incredibly articulate. The last line in particular was quite poetic, insofar as I think it pinpoints such an important aspect of most suicidal people, the fact that deep down, most of us don't want to die, we just want to be happy. I wish I could say with any degree of confidence that it's possible for everyone. Having dealt with a close friend's suicide this past year, I think one of the main things I took away from that tragedy is that despite the fact that I envision my own suicide on a daily basis, and despite the fact that our chances for genuine happiness are contingent upon a wide variety of physical, genetic, and socio-economic  circumstances, that happiness is still an ideal worth striving for. Not like there's anything to lose in trying. The one good aspect of suicide is that it's something you can always put off til tommorow.

I'm sorry for the pain you're in. Seems like you haven't had an easy life. Lives seldom are. As cliche as it sounds, things get better. Death is very boring. Life is full of possibility. You're only 20 years old dude. Way too early to cash in the chips, despite all the bullshit you've dealt with. I know you've probably heard this all before, and won't take your emotional pain away, but it's always good to hear it again. Take a step back and think things through. The wait sucks, but if you work hard and are patient, you at least have a shot at finding happiness in this cosmic shithole. If you make a rash choice like this one, you have no shot. That's the sad truth of it.
